knowledge:
- key_parameters: binGap=m/z tolerance for consecutive feature grouping (default 0.005 Da; increase for larger m/z deviations) ;; windx, windy=retention time windows around anchor points (smaller values increase anchors, including outliers) ;; tolmz, tolQ=restrict m/z and relative abundance (Q) differences of selected anchors ;; tolrtq=restricts linear retention time quantile differences for anchors ;; useID=if TRUE, uses shared identity strings to guide anchor selection or prevent outlier exclusion ;; k=basis dimension for GAM spline-fitting (controls curve flexibility) ;; iterFilter=number of outlier filtering iterations during spline fitting ;; coef, prop=outlier detection thresholds (point is outlier if absolute error to mean absolute error ratio exceeds coef in over prop of model fits) ;; family=scat (robust to outliers but slower) or gaussian (faster but sensitive to outliers) for GAM ;; A, B, C=weights penalizing m/z, RT fit, and Q deviations in scoring (A: 50-120, B: 5-15, C: 0-1) ;; minScore, maxRankX, maxRankY, delta=thresholds for conflict detection and row labeling
- alternatives: fit_loess (LOESS spline fitting) as an alternative to fit_gam (Generalized Additive Models) for non-linear retention time mapping
- when_to_use: When aligning two peak-picked and aligned LC-MS metabolomics datasets acquired in the same ionization mode from biologically similar specimens under similar (but not identical) chromatographic conditions where elution order is mostly preserved
- pitfalls: Do not use with excessively disparate chromatographic techniques (e.g., aligning RPLC to HILIC) ;; Abundance values must not be normalized/transformed in a way that removes their ranked abundance order (Q values depend on ranked abundance) ;; Ensure correct sample and extra column keywords are specified to avoid overlapping columns or incorrect data parsing ;; Ensure no negative m/z or RT values exist in the input data

workflows.name: lc_ms_dataset_alignment
workflows.intent: Align two LC-MS metabolomics datasets by grouping features, mapping retention times with non-linear splines, scoring alignments, and resolving conflicts.
input: dataset1.txt (tab-delimited text file containing m/z, RT, and sample abundance columns for dataset X)
dataset2.txt (tab-delimited text file containing m/z, RT, and sample abundance columns for dataset Y)
workflows.stages: 1. Data Formatting and Filtering ;; 2. Feature m/z Grouping and Pairwise Alignment Detection ;; 3. Anchor Selection ;; 4. Model-fitting / RT Mapping ;; 5. Feature Pair Alignment Scoring ;; 6. Combined Table Reduction and Conflict Labeling ;; 7. Exporting Results
workflows.code:
library(metabCombiner)
data("plasma30")
data("plasma20")
p20 <- metabData(table = plasma20, mz = "mz", rt = "rt", id = "identity", adduct = "adduct", samples = "CHEAR", extra = c("Red", "POOL"), rtmin = "min", rtmax = 17.25, measure = "median", zero = FALSE, duplicate = c(0.0025, 0.05))
p30 <- metabData(table = plasma30, samples = "Red", extra = c("CHEAR", "POOL", "Blank"))
p.combined = metabCombiner(xdata = p30, ydata = p20, binGap = 0.0075)
p.results = combinedTable(p.combined)
p.combined.2 = selectAnchors(p.combined, windx = 0.03,windy = 0.02, tolQ = 0.3, tolmz = 0.003, tolrtq = 0.3, useID = FALSE)
a = getAnchors(p.combined.2)
set.seed(100)
p.combined.3 = fit_gam(p.combined.2, useID = FALSE, k = seq(12,20,2), iterFilter = 2, coef = 2, prop = 0.5, bs = "bs", family = "gaussian", m = c(3,2))
p.combined.4 = calcScores(p.combined.3, A = 70, B = 15, C = 0.5, usePPM = FALSE, useAdduct = FALSE, groups = NULL)
scores = evaluateParams(p.combined.3, A = seq(50, 120, 10), B = 5:15, C = seq(0,1,0.1), usePPM = FALSE, minScore = 0.5, penalty = 10)
combined.table = combinedTable(p.combined.4)
combined.table.2 = labelRows(combined.table, minScore = 0.5, maxRankX = 3, maxRankY = 3, method = "score", delta = 0.2, remove = FALSE, balanced = TRUE)
combined.table.3 = labelRows(combined.table, minScore = 0.5, maxRankX = 3, maxRankY = 3, method = "mzrt", balanced = TRUE, delta = c(0.003,0.5,0.003,0.2))
write2file(combined.table, file = "Combined.Table.Report.txt", sep = "\t")
